newsitem.title: USA: Duke to pay $247 mln for power venture.
newsitem.headline: Duke to pay $247 mln for power venture.

text.p: Duke Power Co said on Friday it had purchased from affiliates of Louis Dreyfus Corp the remaining 50 percent interest in the two companies' power marketing joint venture, Duke/Louis Dreyfus, for $247 million.
Under terms of the purchase, Duke Power will acquire the Louis Dreyfus interest in exchange for $247 million on Aug. 15, 1997. The purchase will be amortized on Duke's books over a 10-year period.

Duke Power will retain continued access to the expertise and experience of the Duke/Louis Dreyfus organization, which will be folded into the power marketing efforts of Duke Energy Trading and Marketing, it said.
Duke Power and PanEnergy Corp announced a $7.7 billion merger on November 25, 1996. The merger is expected to be completed on June 18, 1997.
In 1996, Duke/Louis Dreyfus had electric power marketing sales in excess of $700 million.
